term_trace.Requirement: The SRanger system is a small ground robot that travels in a straight line and turns in place when it detects an obstacle. The robot carries a single infrared (IR) distance sensor mounted facing forward and a differential-drive motor pair that accepts a combined linear / angular velocity command. The controller is reactive: its only sensor input is the IR-driven obstacle event; a system-level endTask event is available to halt the controller. The controller issues motor commands as advisory events to the differential-drive layer.
term_trace.Concept_description: The SRanger system is a small ground robot that travels in a straight line and turns in place when it detects an obstacle.
term_trace.Instance_description: SRanger is the small ground robot system specified by the requirement.

term_trace.Requirement: The SRanger controller is composed of: (1) a Sensor interface that exposes the latest IR distance reading, (2) an Actuator interface that records the last motor command, (3) a small set of state variables (notably a clock-reset timestamp for the timed Turning → Moving transition), and (4) a single state machine that selects transitions based on the input event, the IR distance, and the elapsed time in the current mode.
term_trace.Concept_description: The SRanger controller is composed of interfaces, state variables, and a single state machine.

term_trace.Requirement: The SRanger controller has exactly three operating modes: Moving (initial mode — the robot drives forward at the configured linear velocity), Turning (the robot rotates in place at the configured angular velocity), and Final (a terminal mode entered when the operator issues endTask). At start-up the controller is in Moving.

term_trace.Requirement: The controller maintains a real variable clockResetTime (seconds) recording when the controller most recently entered the Turning state. It is set to the current time as an entry action on the Moving → Turning transition. The autonomous Turning → Moving transition fires when the elapsed time since clockResetTime is at or above turnDuration.
